objective: At the owner's request ('then continue on to i', UNIFORM-FANO-20261107-001's recommendation, rated Payoff 3/3 - Barrier, Concreteness 1/3 - Stated): the scoping step for laws with two kinds of points. Recommendation: Continue, awaiting the owner: grow K_m by a local process (Payoff 2/3 Substantial, Concreteness 2/3 Testable).
